messages:
Ada (AE): Quick heads-up  weve got a POC with OrionGrid next week. Requirements: SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk import (~50k users) + daily deltas, RBAC group-sync and domain ownership proof. Two wrinkles: contractors come through a proxy that rewrites NameID, and they expect a full replace during a short sync window (~400 rps). Also pricing check: Hosted vs Dedicated for sustained SCIM load. Tagging SE + Security. @Rach @Vik

Rach (SE): Clarifying q: does the proxy preserve the IdP issuer? If yes we can canonicalize claims. If it changes issuer well need issuer+subject alias mapping. For SCIM I'd recommend chunked PATCH with page size 500 instead of full PUT replace for 50k.

Priya (Prospect): Proxy keeps the same Azure issuer but rewrites the NameID to a contractor token. We can provide sample CSV + Azure metadata. Peak window ~10m so expect bursts up to ~400 rps.

Marco (Infra): Implementation notes: we support an alias table keyed by (issuer, nameid) -> internal_id and a short cooldown on alias writes to prevent DB hotspots. For bulk imports we prefer a staged ingest API: curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/bulk-import -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@users.csv. We then apply idempotent upserts from a queue.

Vik (Security): Security items to confirm: SCIM bearer token rotation cadence (hourly?) and audit-retention requirement. Hosted supports AES-256 + cloud KMS; BYO-KMS/HSM or isolated audit streams will push them to Private. Also will draft answers for questionnaire (token rotation, KMS, logs, RBAC audit trails).

Ada (AE): Pricing ask: can SE give a quick ballpark for Dedicated commit for a 3-month POC that needs burst to 400 rps and daily 50k churn?

Rach (SE): Ballpark: short-term Dedicated reserved pool (S1 class) with burst; expect mid-five-figure USD/month committed depending on retention and SLA. Short POC commitments often possible with modest uplift; will confirm exact numbers with pricing-ops and post link.

Marco (Infra): POC checklist for engineers: enable name_id_aliases=true, scim_chunk_size=500, scim_throttle=tenant_bucket, alias_write_cooldown=20s, enable RBAC group-to-role mapping and audit events. We'll open a temp rate-limit bump for the POC.

ticket-bot: created ticket POC-99199 "OrionGrid SCIM ingest + NameID aliasing + RBAC mapping" assigned to eng-platform.

Priya (Prospect): Thanks  will upload CSV + metadata by EOD and join the Tue sync. One more q: if we start Dedicated for the POC, can we convert to annual commit later?

Rach (SE): Yes, conversion to an annual reserved plan is supported; pricing-ops will confirm minimums. I'll update this thread with the formal quote once I have it.
